obj/npc/heaven_soldier.c.set_name: name_pick in set: create()'s "天" + order[random(10)] + "神兵", drawn when it is made; only a summoned NPC may draw its name (none is saved alive)
obj/npc/heaven_soldier.c.statement in create(): string *order: the ten stems of name_pick
obj/npc/heaven_soldier.c.function invocation: summoned.arrive in set; it kills the caster's living enemies and each fights back (saveme.c: the fight admits it on the caster's side); set_leader() is not ported: it leaves when the fight ends
obj/npc/heaven_soldier.c.function heal_up: a summoned NPC leaves once its fight is over (heal_up() when not fighting): it leaves when the fight it was called into ends
obj/npc/heaven_soldier.c.function leave: summoned.leave in set, said when it leaves

obj/npc/hell_guard.c.set_name: name_pick in set: create()'s order[random(12)] + "阴鬼卒", drawn when it is made; only a summoned NPC may draw its name
obj/npc/hell_guard.c.statement in create(): string *order: the twelve branches of name_pick
obj/npc/hell_guard.c.set chat_chance: chat_chance with no chat_msg: npc.c chat() says nothing out of a fight
obj/npc/hell_guard.c.set chat_msg_combat: never fires: hell_guard.c sets no chat_chance_combat, so npc.c chat() returns 0 in a fight (its 孽障！随我赴阴司受审吧 is never said)
obj/npc/hell_guard.c.function invocation: summoned.arrive in set (invocation.c's 2 in 3); it kills the caster's living enemies and each fights back; set_leader() is not ported: it leaves when the fight ends
obj/npc/hell_guard.c.function heal_up: a summoned NPC leaves once its fight is over (heal_up() when not fighting)
obj/npc/hell_guard.c.function leave: summoned.leave in set, said when it leaves

obj/npc/mind_bug.c.condition in create(): conjured in set: create() reads this_player(), who practised 茅山道术 (necromancy.c practice_skill()): combat_exp is query_skill("spells", 1) * 500 and bellicosity theirs
obj/npc/mind_bug.c.function die: conjured in set: killed by its owner (last_damage_from), improve_skill("spells", random(spi / 2) + 1); by anyone else, the owner falls unconscious

obj/npc/mind_beast.c.condition in create(): conjured in set: combat_exp is query_skill("spells", 1) * 2000 and bellicosity the owner's
obj/npc/mind_beast.c.function die: conjured in set: killed by its owner, improve_skill("spells", random(spi) + 1); by anyone else, the owner falls unconscious

obj/npc/zombie.c.set chat_chance: chat_chance with no chat_msg: npc.c chat() says nothing out of a fight
obj/npc/zombie.c.set chat_msg_combat: never fires: zombie.c sets no chat_chance_combat, so npc.c chat() returns 0 in a fight (its 荷荷 lines and do_bite() never come)
obj/npc/zombie.c.function is_zombie: raised in set: the NPC 驱尸 (animate.c) makes of a corpse; a 僵尸追魂符 goes only on one
obj/npc/zombie.c.function animate: raised in set: set("possessed", who) is its summoner, set_leader(who) FLAG_FOLLOWS_PLAYER; it follows the player across maps and is not saved (DECISIONS 茅山 A)
obj/npc/zombie.c.function dispell: raised.dissolve in set: said to its room, then destruct() (no corpse)
obj/npc/zombie.c.function heal_up: raised.drain in set: each heal_up() out of a fight takes atman and gin from its master and tells them; at 10 atman or less, or after its sheet's fight (end_tag), it dispells a second later

obj/npc/obj/golden_sword.c.set wield_msg: wield/unwield messages are not shown yet
obj/npc/obj/golden_sword.c.set unwield_msg: wield/unwield messages are not shown yet
